title: CandyCodeWeb — SugarCraft
description: CandyCodeWeb: browser UI for candy-code's WebSocket server mode. A Vite + Vue 3 bundle committed as dist/ and located by a one-class PHP shim, so candy-code serve needs no Node.
ogDescription: The browser face of candy-code's server mode — Vite + Vue 3 + TypeScript + Pinia, shipped pre-built through Composer.
tagline: Browser UI for candy-code's server mode
detailMeta: app satellite web-ui vue vite
